name: Push-up
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels, lower chest to the floor and push back up.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower hips back and down as if sitting into a chair, keep chest up, return to standing.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms and toes on the ground, body in a straight line, brace the core and hold.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lying on a bench, press dumbbells up from chest level until arms are extended, lower with control.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Bar racked across upper back, feet shoulder-width, squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor, drive back up.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, grip the bar just outside the legs, drive through the heels to stand up straight.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip, pull chin above the bar, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Seated or standing, press dumbbells overhead from shoulder height until arms are extended.

name: Lunges
instructions: Step forward, lower until both knees are bent near 90 degrees, push back to start.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Standing, curl dumbbells up toward the shoulders keeping elbows close to the body, lower with control.

name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Hands on a bench or bars behind you, lower body by bending elbows, push back up.

name: Bent-over Row
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, pull the bar toward the lower ribs, lower with control.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Seated in the machine, press the platform away by extending the knees, return with control.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Seated, pull the bar down to upper chest level, control it back up.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Seated, lean back slightly, rotate the torso side to side, feet can stay grounded for an easier version.

name: Burpee
instructions: Drop into a squat, kick feet back to a plank, do a push-up, jump feet back in, then jump up.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: In a plank position, drive knees toward the chest alternately at a quick pace.

name: Jumping Jacks
instructions: Jump feet out while raising arms overhead, jump back to start.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench, bar over hips, drive hips up until torso is parallel to the floor.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Standing, raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, lower with control.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lying or seated in the machine, curl the pad toward the glutes, return with control.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lying on a bench, arms slightly bent, open arms out wide then bring dumbbells back together above the chest.

name: Calf Raise
instructions: Standing, rise onto the balls of the feet, lower with control.

name: Cable Row
instructions: Seated, pull the handle toward the torso keeping the back straight, control it back out.

name: Jump Rope
instructions: Jump rope at a steady pace, landing softly on the balls of the feet.
